$comment: Source file_format_specifications: https://data.igvf.org/documents/ddaf9ce5-471e-4cec-b344-c1071c0362b1/ Catalog nodes group the source rows by program_id; reported_gene_count and file-scoped keys are catalog-derived. Supplied GO annotations are intentionally excluded.

_key.description: Defining gene-program file accession followed by the file-local program ID. Shared programs retain this identity across conditions.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Identifier of the gene program in its defining file, using the GP_{number} naming convention in the gene-program specification.

reported_gene_count.title: Reported Gene Count
reported_gene_count.description: Catalog-derived count of genes reported for this program in the input file; not a field in the source specification and not necessarily the full program size.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, program_id, reported_gene_count, biosample_term, biological_context, treatments_term_ids, perturbation, files_filesets, class, method, label, source, source_url
